meta.title: forlovers: apps built with AI, for the love of building
meta.description: Apps built with AI, for the love of building. No startup, no roadmap: just things we wanted to exist.
manifesto.title: Apps built with AI, for the love of building.
manifesto.body: No startup, no roadmap, no excuses. Just things we wanted to exist, built in the evenings with an AI and a lot of love.
apps.title: Made with love so far
apps.glowtrail.tagline: Every run, ride and hike, glowing on one map
apps.glowtrail.body: A light heatmap of all your sport activities, drawn from your .fit files and kept in sync with Garmin. Zoom from the whole world down to your street.
apps.hashboard.tagline: Your Bitcoin miners, watched from anywhere
apps.hashboard.body: Remote monitoring for AxeOS-compatible ASIC miners. A small feeder on your network pushes the stats; you get a board you can keep private or share.
apps.hashboard.access: Sign in with a magic link
apps.forlovers.tagline: This page, a neon heart for the love of building
apps.forlovers.body: The home of everything above: one neon line that draws a heart, a manifesto, and the list of what we built. Static, light, and ready to speak more languages.
